name: Pause
teaser: A simple SPT mod which allows you to pause the game including the raid timer.
description_html:
⏸️ Pause
A simple SPT mod which allows you to pause the game including the raid timer. Press P to pause.

Mostly cobbled together from Kobrakon’s Take a Break as a learning exercise.

Works with SPT-AKI versions:

- 3.7.1

- 3.7.0

- 3.6.1

- 3.6.0

- 3.5.8

Installation

Installation

Unzip into your SPT plugins folder ([SPT]\BepInEx\plugins).

The default hotkey to pause is set to P.

Issues?

Issues?

  1. Make sure you don’t have any previous versions of the Pause mod installed.
  2. In order to rule out conflicting mods, can you reproduce the issue with only Pause installed? Are there any mods that you think might be conflicting?
  3. PM me your BepInEx\LogOutput.log
What gets paused

What gets paused

  • You
    • Character Control
    • Health
    • Hydration & Energy
    • Stamina
  • AI
    • Bot player models are hidden but their guns will remain visible while paused.
    • Ragdoll physics get reset while paused
  • Day/night cycle
  • The raid timer
    • The raid timer should automatically display and read PAUSED when activated.
What does not pause

What does not pause

These are some things that don’t currently pause and may not be worth the effort really, but just FYI.

  • Grenades (will continue to fly, but fuses won’t tick)
  • You falling/jumping
  • Certain oxygen/stamina effects
    • Pause while aiming continues to drain oxygen
    • Pause while stamina is recovering will continue to recover
  • Can still manage inventory to a degree (should not be able to use items)
    • Maybe we can call this a feature
